title: Tampa Celebrity Homes Boat Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Child rate applies only when sharing with 2 paying adults
Children must be accompanied by an adult
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Are you a baseball fan? Or maybe a hockey fan? Or better yet a football fan? Just a fan of the rich and famous in general? If you said "yes" to any of these questions, then we know you will want to see the homes of the rich and famous celebrities you admire. This is the tour for you!

This is the tour for you. See the BIGGEST home in Tampa owned by a New York Yankee up close. This tour lasts one hour and will take you into Tampa Bay to see the homes on Davis Islands. There are canals lined with the grandest homes in the city. We get visited by dolphins on most trips as they play and hunt for dinner.
